twoFactor.emailCodeDescription: Enter the code we just emailed you

twoFactor.couldNotSendCode: Couldn't send a code. Try again.

verifyEmail.sentDescription: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Click it to activate your account, then sign in.

verifyEmail.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or expired
verifyEmail.invalidDescription: Verification links expire after an hour and can only be used once. Enter your email to get a new one.
verifyEmail.resent: If that account still needs verification, we sent a new link. Check your email.
verifyEmail.emailUnavailable: Email delivery isn't configured on this server. Ask an administrator to verify your account.
verifyEmail.accountCreatedNoEmail: Your account for {{email}} was created, but email delivery isn't configured on this server, so no verification link was sent. Ask an administrator to verify your account before signing in.
verifyEmail.notVerified: Verify your email before signing in. Check your inbox for the verification link.

mcpLogin.title: Sign in to continue
mcpLogin.description: An application is asking to connect to your account.
mcpLogin.clientDescription: {{client}} is asking to connect to your account.
mcpLogin.reauthDescription: Access for {{client}} was revoked. Sign in again to give it access again.
mcpLogin.invalidTitle: This sign-in request is not valid

mcpLogin.signOutFailed: Could not sign out. The session is still active — try again.

mcpConsent.description: {{client}} is requesting access to your account.
mcpConsent.noScopes: No access was requested with this authorization.
mcpConsent.readOnlyRequested: This agent asked for read-only access, so it gets Read-only.
mcpConsent.deniedDescription: The application did not get access. You can close this window and return to it.
mcpConsent.invalidTitle: This authorization request is no longer valid
mcpConsent.invalidDescription: The request may have expired or its signature is invalid. Start again from the application.
mcpConsent.manageNote: You can review and revoke this access at any time in Access → Agents.

read.name: Read access
read.description: View your dashboard data, model pools, provider accounts, and usage.

write.name: Read and write access
write.description: The agent also asked to make changes. Choose below what it may do.

offline_access.name: Background renewal
offline_access.description: Renew access in the background without asking you to sign in again. Renewal expires after 72 hours of inactivity, and you can revoke it at any time in Access → Agents.

scopes.additionalDescription: This application requested an access level this server does not document. Review it before authorizing.
